title: Brake lines cut after leaving BAE

tellings.quote: much. Uh but per the police, yes, my brake lines were cut 100%.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former intelligence specialist who has gone public with claims about secret UFO programmes, says that after he left the defense contractor BAE, someone cut the brake lines on his car. He tells Michels that "per the police, yes, my brake lines were cut 100%", citing their investigation, which would mean someone tried to harm him after he left.
